experiments.hypothesis: Removing a truly useful champion information layer should prospectively worsen paired proper scores; layers that do not worsen scores are candidates for simplification.
experiments.training_period: none; deterministic counterfactual from persisted PIT pregame components
experiments.validation_period: first post-registration SCHEDULED_FINAL FINAL 10-60m certification snapshot per settled game
experiments.primary_metric: paired Brier gain of champion vs each declared ablation
experiments.success_rule: A component is supported only if champion-minus-ablation paired Brier CI95 lower > 0 with LogLoss non-regression; lack of evidence triggers simplification research, not automatic removal.
experiments.analysis_plan: Generate fixed no-X counterfactual probabilities from immutable pregame component deltas and score each against the champion on identical first SCHEDULED_FINAL FINAL 10-60m post-registration games.
experiments.stopping_rule: No component-removal decision before 250 independent games; no adding/removing ablation definitions after scoring begins without a new experiment id.
experiments.promotion_scope: Diagnostic/simplification nomination only; removing any champion component requires explicit new generation validation.
